draft_en.subject: A budget band below Cisco and Netgear for your project procurement - two numbers
draft_en.body:
Dear Mr. Ridder,

We wrote to you once in February 2025 about a 16-port PoE managed switch, and since then only general product mails - most recently "16 Port Industrial PoE Switch" on 23 September 2026 - none of which needed an answer. This one is specific.

For the PoE switches you procure for customer projects next to Cisco and Netgear, a neutral-brand budget band at distributor price, EXW, MOQ 1, 15-day validity, CE/RoHS: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $80.7 USD; 24 x Gigabit PoE+ (280 W) + 4 x SFP, L2+ managed - STC-424DGGPM-280W - $134.5. English web GUI; CE DoC and RoHS files go with the first order.

One question: is there a budget band your customers ask for below the branded lines - and is it the 8-port or the 24-port they ask about?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
